purpose: Bounded public Pretoria/Tshwane registered parcel qualification using the repository ArcGIS adapter, followed by exact native-key reads and independent topology audit. No title-deed or ownership fields were requested; no geometries except three privacy-safe features are written to the research folder.

transport.tls: official GeoTrust TLS RSA CA G1 intermediate appended to rootCertificates; rejectUnauthorized=true

scope.reason: The service WAF returns HTTP 403 for multi-value IN/OR/exclusion predicates. Registered equality query supports count, manifest, and geometry. Now Scheme has 14,864 service-wide records but remains excluded because its legal/current-ground semantics are not defined by service coded domains.

identityCaveat: lis_key is a string native plot reference but service index is non-unique. Spatial sample and exact global equality reads check duplicates only for encountered keys; no global uniqueness guarantee.

requests.toolOutcome: Direct public lis_key equality query (the ArcGIS adapter native queryIds path uses IN and is rejected by the WAF).

runtime.privacy: outFields contain only OBJECTID, lis_key, parcel_label, status_lu_text, type_lu_text and geometry. Full source geometry remains in /tmp; published sample contains at most three polygons.
runtime.result: partial: registered viewport geometry and paging passed; adapter queryIds compatibility blocked by provider HTTP 403

adapterQualification: partial; adapter-generated native queryIds path is rejected with provider HTTP 403
